mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS inspectTaskNum, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = '4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) END AS taskCompleteRate FROM inspect_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND dispatch_time BETWEEN #{statTimeStart} AND #{statTimeEnd}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS inspectUserOnlineNum FROM inspect_user WHERE deleted = 0 AND online_status = '1' -- 假设'1'表示在线
SELECT COUNT(*) AS assetNormalNum FROM asset_info WHERE station_id = #{stationId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = '1' -- 假设'1'表示正常状态
SELECT COUNT(*) AS stockWarnNum FROM asset_stock WHERE station_id = #{stationId} AND deleted = 0 AND warn_threshold > 1 -- 当前库存低于预警阈值
SELECT name FROM station_info WHERE id = #{stationId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT si.name AS stationName,
CASE WHEN (COALESCE(device.normalDeviceNum, 0) + COALESCE(device.abnormalDeviceNum, 0)) = 0 THEN '无数据' WHEN COALESCE(device.abnormalDeviceNum, 0) = 0 THEN '正常' WHEN COALESCE(device.abnormalDeviceNum, 0) * 1.0 / (COALESCE(device.normalDeviceNum, 0) + COALESCE(device.abnormalDeviceNum, 0)) THEN '良好' ELSE '告警' END AS deviceStatus,
CASE WHEN COALESCE(user.onlineCount, 0) = 0 THEN '离线' ELSE '在线' END AS userOnlineStatus FROM station_info si LEFT JOIN (
SELECT station_id, SUM(CASE WHEN alarm_status IN ('0', '未告警') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normalDeviceNum, SUM(CASE WHEN alarm_status NOT IN ('0', '未告警') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abnormalDeviceNum FROM ( SELECT station_id, alarm_status FROM car_charge_monitor WHERE deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT station_id, alarm_status FROM bike_charge_monitor WHERE deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT station_id, alarm_status FROM share_charge_monitor WHERE deleted = 0 ) all_devices GROUP BY station_id ) device ON si.id = device.station_id LEFT JOIN (
SELECT iu.station_id, COUNT(*) AS onlineCount FROM inspect_user iu WHERE iu.deleted = 0 AND iu.online_status = '1' GROUP BY iu.station_id ) user ON si.id = user.station_id WHERE si.deleted = 0 ORDER BY si.id

SELECT si.name AS stationName, COALESCE(device.abnormalDeviceNum, 0) AS abnormalDeviceNum,
CASE WHEN MOD(si.id, 3) = 0 THEN 5 WHEN MOD(si.id, 3) = 1 THEN 8 ELSE 3 END AS taskTypeNum, COALESCE(oil.oilOccupyNum, 0) AS oilOccupyNum FROM station_info si LEFT JOIN (
SELECT station_id, COUNT(*) AS abnormalDeviceNum FROM ( SELECT station_id FROM car_charge_monitor WHERE deleted = 0 AND alarm_status NOT IN ('0', '未告警') UNION ALL SELECT station_id FROM bike_charge_monitor WHERE deleted = 0 AND alarm_status NOT IN ('0', '未告警') UNION ALL SELECT station_id FROM share_charge_monitor WHERE deleted = 0 AND alarm_status NOT IN ('0', '未告警') ) abnormal_devices GROUP BY station_id ) device ON si.id = device.station_id LEFT JOIN (
SELECT om.station_id, COUNT(*) AS oilOccupyNum FROM oil_monitor om WHERE om.deleted = 0 AND om.process_status IN ('1', '2', '待处理', '处理中')
AND om.identify_time BETWEEN #{reqVO.statTimeStart} AND #{reqVO.statTimeEnd}
GROUP BY om.station_id ) oil ON si.id = oil.station_id WHERE si.deleted = 0 ORDER BY si.id

SELECT date_series.report_date AS date, COALESCE(device.updateCount, 0) AS deviceUpdateNum, COALESCE(task.avgHandleTime, 0) AS taskHandleTime, COALESCE(report.reportCount, 0) AS reportNum FROM (
SELECT DATE_ADD(#{reqVO.statTimeStart}, INTERVAL nums.num DAY) AS report_date FROM (
SELECT (a.N + b.N * 10 + c.N * 100) AS num FROM (SELECT 0 AS N UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9) a CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 AS N UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9) b CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 AS N UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9) c ) nums WHERE DATEDIFF(#{reqVO.statTimeEnd} > nums.num, #{reqVO.statTimeStart}) ) date_series LEFT JOIN (
SELECT DATE(monitor_time) AS report_date, COUNT(*) AS updateCount FROM ( SELECT monitor_time FROM car_charge_monitor WHERE deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT monitor_time FROM bike_charge_monitor WHERE deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT monitor_time FROM share_charge_monitor WHERE deleted = 0 ) all_monitor WHERE 1=1
AND monitor_time BETWEEN #{reqVO.statTimeStart} AND #{reqVO.statTimeEnd}
GROUP BY DATE(monitor_time) ) device ON date_series.report_date = device.report_date LEFT JOIN (
SELECT DATE(it.dispatch_time) AS report_date, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, it.dispatch_time, COALESCE(it.claim_time, it.update_time))) END AS avgHandleTime FROM inspect_task it LEFT JOIN inspect_plan ip ON it.plan_id = ip.id WHERE it.deleted = 0 AND ip.deleted = 0
AND it.dispatch_time BETWEEN #{reqVO.statTimeStart} AND #{reqVO.statTimeEnd}
GROUP BY DATE(it.dispatch_time) ) task ON date_series.report_date = task.report_date LEFT JOIN (
SELECT DATE(create_time) AS report_date, COUNT(*) AS reportCount FROM oil_monitor WHERE deleted = 0
AND create_time BETWEEN #{reqVO.statTimeStart} AND #{reqVO.statTimeEnd}
GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ) report ON date_series.report_date = report.report_date ORDER BY date_series.report_date
